description: 2 tactical challenges for Black in the Albin Countergambit. Answer 2.c4 with the shocking 2...e5! and build the d4 wedge.

drills.briefExplanation: 2...e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.g3 Nge7 — Black sacrifices a pawn for the mighty d4 wedge.
drills.description: Black to play. White offers the Queen's Gambit with 2.c4 — counter with the Albin 2...e5!.
drills.explanation: The Albin Countergambit: instead of defending the gambit pawn, Black counterattacks in the center. After 3.dxe5 d4 the d-pawn becomes a wedge cramping White's whole game. The main line continues 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.g3 Nge7 — Black reroutes to g6, eyeing e5 and f4, and will follow with ...Bg2-challenging ...Be6, ...Qd7 and long castling into a kingside attack.
drills.name: The Albin Countergambit

drills.briefExplanation: 5...Nge7 6.Bg2 Ng6 7.O-O Be6 8.b3 Qd7 9.Bb2 O-O-O — complete development and castle into the attack.
drills.description: Black to play. The wedge stands on d4 and White has fianchettoed — finish development and castle long.
drills.explanation: With the d4 wedge fixed, Black's plan is pure Albin: knights to c6 and g6, bishop to e6 pressuring c4, queen to d7, and 9...O-O-O castling directly into a kingside pawn storm. White's extra e-pawn is a static weakness Black will hunt with ...Ngxe5 ideas — the wedge does the strategic work while the pieces do the attacking.
drills.name: Castling Into the Attack

name: Albin Countergambit — Black Tactics
